note.question: What determines BOGO in manufacturer–retailer supply chains?
note.overview: Buy-one-get-one (BOGO) promotions have become popular. With BOGO, the first unit is sold for the regular price, and the second unit is discounted. The paper analyzes BOGO in manufacturer–retailer supply chains.

source.quote: We analyze BOGO in manufacturer–retailer supply chains.
We analyze BOGO in manufacturer–retailer supply chains.

We find that, for some products, whether consumers stockpile or not, if BOGO and PR have the same market size, BOGO has a larger retailer profit and the same or larger manufacturer profit because BOGO induces more consumers to buy and consume two units.
We incorporate mar­ ket size uncertainty resulting from promotion-caused brand switching.
The manufacturer decides wb and η, and the retailer decides pb.
